	type = country_event

	title = societal_values.2021.t
	desc = societal_values.2021.desc
	outcome = neutral


	trigger = {
		societal_value:outward_vs_inward < -25
		any_trade = { exists = this }
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
	}

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = happy
		10 = exterior
	}

	immediate = {
        event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate }
		every_trade = {
			to_market = {
				owner ?= {
					save_temporary_scope_as = temp_c
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								this = root
							}
						}
						add_to_list = countries_trading_with
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = societal_values.2021.a

		change_gold_effect = { scale = -2 }

		every_in_list = {
			list = countries_trading_with
			add_opinion = {
				modifier = opinion_diplomatic_move
				target = root
			}
		}

		change_societal_value = {
			type = outward_vs_inward
			value = societal_value_minor_move_to_left
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = societal_values.2021.b

		ordered_market_present_in_country = {
			add_merchant_power = {
				country = root
				key = merchant_power_key_local_trade_focus
				months = 120
				power = merchant_power_mild_bonus
			}
		}

		change_societal_value = {
			type = outward_vs_inward
			value = societal_value_minor_move_to_right
		}
	}
}

	type = country_event

	desc = societal_values.2108.desc

	}

		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate }
	}

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_age = age_5_absolutism
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
		}
		societal_value:absolutism_vs_liberalism < 0
		capital = {
			market ?= {
				any_import = {
					owner ?= root
					from_market ?= {
						location = {
							NOT = {

							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = societal_values.2108.a

		if = {
			limit = {
				current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
			}
			change_societal_value = {
				type = mercantilism_vs_free_trade
				value = societal_value_move_to_right
			}
		}
		add_estate_satisfaction = {
			type = estate_type:burghers_estate
			value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = societal_values.2108.b

		if = {
			limit = {
				current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
			}
			change_societal_value = {
				type = mercantilism_vs_free_trade
				value = societal_value_move_to_left
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
		}
	}
}

		societal_value:absolutism_vs_liberalism < -33
		has_ruler = yes
		ruler ?= { total_abilities <= 150 }
	}

	option = {
		name = societal_values.2114.a

		add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_penalty
	}
}

REPLACE:societal_values.2200 = {
	type = country_event
	title = societal_values.2200.title
	desc = societal_values.2200.desc
	outcome = neutral

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = happy
		10 = interior
	}

	immediate = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate }

		random_province = {
			limit = {
				province_average_control > 0.60
				province_tax_base >= 0.1
			}
			save_scope_as = target_province
		}
	}

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_age = age_5_absolutism
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
		}
		societal_value:absolutism_vs_liberalism > 0
		any_province = {
			province_average_control > 0.60
			province_tax_base >= 0.1
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = societal_values.2200.a

		scope:target_province = {
			every_location_in_province = {
				change_development = development_weak_bonus
			}
		}
		change_societal_value = {
			type = absolutism_vs_liberalism
			value = societal_value_move_to_right
		}
	}
}

	type = country_event
	title = societal_values.2212.title
	desc = societal_values.2212.desc
	outcome = neutral

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = regular
		10 = interior
	}

	immediate = {
        event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:nobles_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate }

		random_province = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					province_definition = owner.capital.province_definition
				}
				province_average_control > 0.2
				province_average_control < 0.9
			}
			save_scope_as = target_province
		}
	}

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_age = age_5_absolutism
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
		}
		societal_value:absolutism_vs_liberalism > 25

		any_province = {
			NOT = {
				province_definition = owner.capital.province_definition
			}
			province_average_control > 0.2
			province_average_control < 0.9
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = societal_values.2212.a

		scope:target_province = {
			every_location_in_province = {
				change_control = control_mild_penalty
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = societal_values.2212.b

		add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
	}

REPLACE:societal_values.2213 = {
	type = country_event
	title = societal_values.2213.title
	desc = societal_values.2213.desc
	outcome = neutral

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = regular
		10 = interior
	}

	immediate = {
        event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:nobles_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate }

		random_artist = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					artist_type = writer
					artist_type = philosopher
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = target_artist
		}
		random_neighbor_country = {
			save_scope_as = exile_destination
		}
	}

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_age = age_5_absolutism
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
		}
		societal_value:absolutism_vs_liberalism > 75

		any_artist = {
			OR = {
				artist_type = writer
				artist_type = philosopher
			}
		}
		any_neighbor_country = {
			exists = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = societal_values.2213.a

		change_societal_value = {
			type = absolutism_vs_liberalism
			value = societal_value_move_to_left
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = societal_values.2213.b

		scope:target_artist = {
			move_country = scope:exile_destination
		}
	}
}
